title: Building Trust Through Technology: AI, Public Service Perception, and Citizen Satisfaction in Abu Dhabi Policing
core_idea: Examine how AI implementation, perceptions of public services, and trust in government relate to citizen satisfaction within Abu Dhabi Police by developing a conceptual framework informed by public value theory, expectation-confirmation theory, and IT assimilation theory; empirically test direct and mediated relationships using a purposive survey of police employees (365 valid responses) and PLS-SEM analysis.
tldr: Investigate the relationships among AI deployment, public service perceptions, and government trust to explain citizen satisfaction in Abu Dhabi policing using a theory-driven framework and survey-based PLS-SEM analysis.
